source_identity_rule: E01..E08 names, CON-161..240 and SB-ASI-P2593..P3072 remain approved source identities. AI/ASI ownership below is a Phase-2 functional mapping and does not rewrite source records.

elements.name: State and Signal Intake
elements.boundary: AI acquires/estimates input state; ASI governs scope, provenance and epistemic admissibility where required.

elements.name: Pattern and Context Integration
elements.boundary: AI builds/links context and patterns; ASI governs cross-domain ownership and durable memory effects.

elements.name: Prediction and Counterfactual Simulation
elements.boundary: AI generates predictions/counterfactuals; ASI governs uncertainty, long-horizon consequence scope and meta-audit.

elements.name: Decision and Priority Arbitration
elements.boundary: AI forms and compares candidate paths; ASI owns cross-domain priority, rule/value conflict and authority arbitration.

elements.name: Action and Execution Control
elements.boundary: AI plans/performs legal operations; ASI owns permission, barrier, resource conflict, high-level control and governed continuation.

elements.name: Verification and Uncertainty Control
elements.boundary: AI executes tests, calibration and contradiction detection; ASI governs truth/provenance acceptance, unresolved contradiction and meta-audit.

elements.name: Memory and Learning Integration
elements.boundary: AI can form/retrieve/compress learning candidates; ASI governs durable write-back, evolution, versioning, inheritance and law/principle formation.

elements.name: Governance, Safety and Recovery
elements.boundary: AI supplies detection, diagnostics and recovery mechanisms; ASI owns governance, permission, safety barriers, escalation, version/recovery policy and conflict arbitration.

hard_guards: AI_PRIMARY does not mean autonomous authority; applicable ASI rules and Universal Sequence barriers still govern execution.
SHARED_AI_ASI means mechanism and governance are distinct responsibilities, not duplicated parameters.
ASI_PRIMARY does not mean ASI performs every low-level mechanism; AI/Engine operators can supply evidence and candidate operations.
No ownership mapping may modify source parameter identity, container identity, Engine relation or cognitive-source relation.
No Engine becomes a controller merely because it is bound to an ASI Node.
